ai.note: No model, prompt, run identity or confidence was captured in this snapshot. The decisions below are derived from the artifacts, not supplied by the generator.

decisions.title: One logical asset backs five relations
decisions.rationale: The asset is the logical unit of source data. Its optional layout members map each relation to a JSON document or partition; relations do not own separate assets.

decisions.title: Source nullability is observed, not declared
decisions.rationale: The asset semantics record that nullability is not declared by the JSON documents. Field declarations therefore carry value types; source access supplies the nullable wrapper at read time.

decisions.title: Defect identity rejects null IDs
decisions.rationale: The defect binding applies drop_null to defect.defect_id before using it as the node identity.

decisions.title: Missing condition ratings fall back to Unrated
decisions.rationale: The condition_rating property is a coalesce expression whose second argument is the literal 'Unrated'. This is a visible, auditable default rather than an inferred one.

decisions.title: One reading node type is fed by temperature and vibration
decisions.rationale: Bindings 4 and 5 both target node reading, from temperature and vibration respectively, and publish the same property set.

decisions.title: One measures edge type is fed by temperature and vibration
decisions.rationale: Bindings 12 and 13 both target edge measures. The reviewer must decide whether one relationship type is correct or whether the two logger families need distinct relationship semantics.

decisions.title: Every graph artifact is published to file, meta graph and Neo4j
decisions.rationale: The deduplicated node and edge artifacts feed all three terminal components: file write, meta-graph document and the Neo4j import bundle.

decisions.title: The reference build reports no recovered or unresolved failures
decisions.rationale: Both failure arrays in the build report are empty. This is a build-health observation, not proof that every design decision is correct.
